node.statement: A full second global polar datum is stronger than necessary: by validated 1.7.5.2, for each relevant X it would suffice to know X in S_delta, u_grp(X) in calU, and some h_X in B_delta^{calH}(J) with Pi_delta(u_grp(X),h_X)=X. Injectivity of the diffeomorphism would then give u_grp(X)=u_pol(X). But validated 1.7.5.2-1.7.5.3 record that the allowed group-laws contract supplies none of these pointwise synchronization premises at X=U bold-dot V or X=U^dagger.
